shell_commands: /usr/bin/zsh -lc "pwd && sed -n '1,240p' ../ticket.md && if [ -f ../round-brief.md ]; then sed -n '1,260p' ../round-brief.md; fi && sed -n '1,260p' .lore/dod.md"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git status --short --branch && git log -5 --oneline && sed -n '1,220p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestratorUsage.acceptance.test.ts && sed -n '1,220p' specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md && sed -n '1,100p' CHANGELOG.md && rg -n \"totalUsage|lastUsage|afterModelResponse|Usage\" src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts src/types/ai.ts src/index.ts src/types/index.ts"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,230p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts && sed -n '1,180p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestratorTotalUsage.test.ts && git show --stat --oneline 28e1cdf && git show --format=fuller --no-ext-diff 28e1cdf -- src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts src/orchestration/chatOrchestratorTotalUsage.test.ts .lore/dod.md && sed -n '1,160p' .lore/test-commands.yml && cat package.json"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'rg -n "specs/.+#|@spec|spec:" src/**/*.test.ts | head -80 && rg -n "validated by.*acceptance|counts reported rounds" specs adrs 2>/dev/null || true && ls scripts/spec-links 2>/dev/null || true && rg -n "reanchor" scripts package.json'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'npx prettier --write src/orchestration/chatOrchestratorTotalUsage.test.ts specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md CHANGELOG.md .lore/dod.md && timeout 300 npm test -- --runTestsByPath src/orchestration/chatOrchestratorTotalUsage.test.ts'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "nl -ba src/orchestration/chatOrchestratorTotalUsage.test.ts | sed -n '1,150p' && nl -ba src/orchestration/chatOrchestratorUsage.acceptance.test.ts | sed -n '38,105p' && git diff --check && git diff -- .lore/dod.md CHANGELOG.md specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md src/orchestration/chatOrchestratorTotalUsage.test.ts && git status --short"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'npx prettier --write specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md .lore/dod.md && git diff --check && git status --short && git diff --stat && git add .lore/dod.md CHANGELOG.md specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md src/orchestration/chatOrchestratorTotalUsage.test.ts && git commit -m "test(orchestrator): cover missing round usage" && git push origin HEAD'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git fetch origin main && git merge --no-edit origin/main && git push origin HEAD && git status --short --branch'
